name: Withermold

source.title: Pathfinder #211: The Secret of Deathstalk Tower

stealth.details: (master) (or +30 and expert if a PC critically succeeded at Recalling Knowledge about the campsite's condition)

disable: DC 33 Religion check (master) twice to exorcise the unholy presence within the withermold, or DC 35 Survival check (master) twice to safely remove the sensory tendrils growing in the mold
reset: A withermold deactivates at the end of any round when there are no targets within reach to attack with thorny vine Strikes. It resets immediately unless it's used all its Spore Burst reactions for the day, in which case the withermold resets in 24 hours.
routine: (3 actions) A withermold makes three Strikes with its thorny vines on its turn, splitting its Strikes up among potential targets before striking a single target more than once.

items.name: Spore Burst
items.text:
Frequency three times per day

Trigger A Small or larger creature touches or attempts to enter one of the three tents

---
Effect The thorny vines of the three withermolds growing on the tents suddenly whip into a frenzy, filling the air with clouds of toxic spores. All creatures within a tent or within 10 feet of a tent's exterior take 8d6 poison damage (DC 32 basic Fortitude save save). The withermolds then roll initiative.

text: Coils of pale yellow thorny fungal vines on which grow hundreds of brown puffballs suddenly whip into frenzied life.
